meta.purpose: Independently authored expected queries + results. Checks that an enquiry produces the INTENDED query (date/interval/slot/seat) and the right deterministic result — not merely self-consistency with the response's own echoed query. Hand-computed against the synthetic fixtures (demo clock 2026-10-27 10:00 IST).
